Balaji Amines Limited is an Indian chemical manufacturer known for its expertise in aliphatic amines, amine derivatives, and select specialty chemicals that serve as key building blocks across multiple industries. Headquartered at 165-A, Railway Lines, Solapur – 413001, Maharashtra, India, the company supports a diverse customer base in pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, personal care, water treatment, refineries, dyes and pigments, and performance materials. Over the years, Balaji Amines has earned a reputation for consistent quality, reliable supply, and technical competence, combining scale manufacturing with application-focused support to help customers improve productivity and meet stringent regulatory requirements.

The company’s portfolio typically spans primary, secondary, and tertiary amines and a range of downstream derivatives tailored to end-use performance needs. A disciplined approach to process design, solvent handling, and purification enables Balaji Amines to address demanding specifications common to regulated sectors such as pharma and crop protection. The organization emphasizes R&D, process optimization, and continuous improvement, working to enhance yields, reduce impurities, and develop new chemistries aligned with evolving customer and market needs.

Safety and environmental stewardship are core priorities. Balaji Amines invests in compliance systems, trained operating teams, and responsible waste and emissions management to support safe operations and sustainable growth. Integrated utilities, robust logistics from its Maharashtra base, and customer-centric service models contribute to dependable delivery across India and export markets. From pilot to commercial scale, the company partners with customers to co-develop solutions, secure long-term supply, and ensure end-to-end technical support—positioning Balaji Amines Limited as a trusted, long-term supplier in critical chemical value chains.
